findings.title: Missing cache recheck after acquiring write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets uses a double-checked locking pattern but only reads entryPointAssetsCache before taking the write lock. If another goroutine populates the cache between the RUnlock and Lock, this goroutine still reloads assets and overwrites entryPointAssetsCache at line 69. If that reload fails, a valid cached value can be replaced with nil; even when it succeeds, it causes redundant disk reads. After acquiring the write lock, re-check `cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil` and return the existing cached value.

findings.title: Exclusive lock held while loading assets from disk/CDN
findings.body: The write lock is held for the entire load path, including readWebAssetsFromCDN/readWebAssetsFromFile and cfg.GetContentDeliveryURL. This serializes all callers on a cache miss and, in dev mode, on every call; if the CDN path is ever enabled, a slow network request would block all GetWebAssets callers. Consider loading outside the lock, for example with singleflight, and publishing the result under the lock.
